verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML decisioning platform, so PEP screening is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, only offers generic AML claims and a passing reference to watchlist updates triggering webhooks. Nothing documents identifying politically exposed persons, their relatives or close associates, or the source context behind a match.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can identify politically exposed persons and related associates with supporting source context
